source.source_title: Guidance Note 7B on the implementation of various aspects of the Financial Intelligence Centre Act

locator.locator_text: Preface, disclaimer and version statement, page 3 of 77
locator.quote: This guidance does not provide legal advice and is not intended to replace the FIC Act.

source_gate.gate_reason: The source pack allows current Guidance Note 7B to provide labelled interpretive context but blocks binding-obligation extraction.

classification.classification_rationale: The FIC issued the document as guidance under its statutory guidance function and the document expressly says it does not replace the Act.

obligation.object_or_outcome: use Guidance Note 7B as interpretive context rather than a replacement for the FIC Act
trigger_conditions: Guidance Note 7B is used in an AML/CFT assessment

timing.value: when the guidance is relied on

exceptions_and_dependencies: binding obligations must be supported by an admitted authoritative instrument
evidence_or_reporting_requirements: record the guidance classification and the binding source used for any obligation
obligation.atomic_summary: Use Guidance Note 7B as labelled interpretive context and preserve responsibility for legal interpretation.
interpretation_notes: This is a guidance-context record, not a binding obligation record.
The schema uses obligation-shaped fields so the downstream workflow can test whether source status is preserved.

applicability.rationale: This record controls how the source may be used and does not decide institution-level applicability.

change.change_summary: Guidance Note 7B replaced Revised Guidance Note 7A and the earlier listed guidance versions on publication.

operating_impact.rationale: The guidance version change may affect interpretation, RMCP review and staff guidance after human assessment.

limitations: The record does not extract or approve a binding statutory obligation.
Operational impact remains a review proposal.
assessment.next_action: Confirm which existing interpretations, RMCP sections and training material require review because of the guidance update.
